en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a street lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. Two tall church spires rise in the background. People walk along the street and sidewalks, and bicycles or carts are visible in the foreground. Decorative script at the bottom reads "Grimma i. Sa. Leipzigerstraße," indicating it depicts Leipzigerstraße in the town of Grimma. Shop signs in German are visible on the left side of the street.
